description: This file defines the public API for Time-aware GPIO drivers in the Zephyr project, including enums, function prototypes, and system call interfaces.

methods.name: tgpio_port_get_time
methods.description: Retrieves the current time from the TGPIO device timer.

methods.name: z_impl_tgpio_port_get_time
methods.description: Implementation inline function calling the driver API to get time.

methods.name: tgpio_port_get_cycles_per_second
methods.description: Retrieves the current running rate in cycles per second.

methods.name: z_impl_tgpio_port_get_cycles_per_second
methods.description: Implementation inline function calling the driver API to get cycles per second.
